title: Cold Chain Inspection Checklist Form
subtitle: Set the cold chain inspection scope, test readiness and requirement-level evidence, contain deficiencies, authorize status, and preserve qualified closeout.
description: An original, fillable cold chain inspection checklist form for controlling temperature-controlled consignment and product-integrity record through inspection checklist identity, observations, evidence, decision, exceptions, escalation, completion, handoff, and final verification without replacing applicable requirements or professional review.
use_case: Use when a cold-chain logistics coordinator or qualified inspector must evaluate temperature-controlled consignment and product-integrity record against the shipping protocol, product requirements, lane plan, and logger instructions and provide a traceable basis for release, restriction, hold, correction, or rejection.

sections.title: Cold Chain inspection checklist identity and routing
sections.guidance: Anchor the record to the exact work, parties, locations, and source references.

fields.label: Shipment, order, lane, and protocol reference
Lot, pallet, shipper, logger, sensor, or seal ID

blocks.label: Responsible parties and route points

fields.label: Trained Cold-Chain Shipper, Carrier, And Receiver
Qualified storage, pack-out, and loading location

blocks.guidance: Preserve linkage to the shipping protocol, product requirements, lane plan, and logger instructions.

sections.title: Cold Chain inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Define the exact population and review basis so inspection conclusions remain bounded.

fields.label: Shipping Protocol, Product Requirements, Lane Plan, And Logger Instructions

blocks.label: Cold Chain readiness verification
items: Product, lot, quantity, approved range, exposure limit, and route are identified
Qualified packaging configuration, coolant, conditioning, and pack-out are confirmed
Vehicle or container is clean, compatible, and preconditioned when required
Calibrated logger or sensor identity, placement, start, and alarm settings are recorded
Loading sequence, door-open control, segregation, and contamination prevention are assigned
Carrier and receiver understand monitoring, delay, power-loss, and handoff responsibilities
Quarantine space and qualified excursion-review contacts are available
No product is released after uncertain control until qualified disposition is documented
blocks.guidance: A failed readiness item must be resolved, excluded with rationale, or carried into the exception section.

sections.title: Cold Chain requirement-level inspection results
sections.guidance: Record actual observations against explicit criteria and identify the evidence for each result.

blocks.label: Cold Chain detailed inspection points
items: Shipment, product, lot, quantity, lane, and approved temperature range agree
Packaging configuration and coolant match the approved shipping protocol
Coolant conditioning and pack-out timing are within the defined work instruction
Logger or sensor identity, calibration status, battery, placement, and start are verified
Vehicle or compartment is clean, compatible, and preconditioned where required
Seal, shipper, pallet, and tamper condition are documented at each custody point
Door-open time, staging exposure, delays, and power interruptions are recorded
Arrival product, ambient, display, and logger status support an initial assessment
Alarm, excursion, missing data, damage, or contamination triggers quarantine
Only a qualified reviewer may authorize product disposition under applicable requirements
blocks.guidance: Checkboxes indicate that the point was examined; the result table carries findings and evidence.

sections.title: Cold Chain measurements and evidence package
sections.guidance: Preserve readings, instruments, identity, and evidence needed to reproduce the inspection decision.

blocks.label: Measurement, count, or verification log
blocks.guidance: Use the method applicable to Shipped, monitored, received, and disposition quantity and Product, shipper, coolant, seal, and logger condition.

blocks.label: Available inspection evidence
items: Approved shipping protocol and lane record
Product, lot, quantity, and pack-out record
Coolant conditioning and packaging configuration
Logger identity, calibration, start, and placement
Vehicle preconditioning and loading observation
Custody, seal, delay, and door-open events
Arrival readings and downloaded temperature history
Qualified excursion assessment and product disposition

blocks.label: Inspection observations, sampling limitations, and evidence interpretation

fields.label: Inspection observations, sampling limitations, and evidence interpretation

sections.title: Cold Chain exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, affected scope, immediate control, owner, deadline, and escalation reconstructable.

blocks.label: Cold Chain exception indicators
items: Product, lot, quantity, range, route, or protocol mismatch
Packaging or coolant configuration differs from the approved pack-out
Logger missing, expired, uncalibrated, failed, stopped, or incorrectly placed
Vehicle or container not clean, compatible, or adequately preconditioned
Seal damage, shipper damage, leakage, contamination, or tampering
Temperature alarm, excursion, freeze event, or missing data interval
Delay, door-open exposure, power interruption, or unplanned transfer
Receiving site cannot maintain quarantine or controlled storage
Product released, moved, sold, or used before qualified disposition
Custody, timing, or evidence cannot reconstruct the exposure history
blocks.guidance: Select every observed condition; do not use a generic exception mark when the actual trigger is known.

sections.title: Cold Chain inspection status and release decision
sections.guidance: Do not turn a checklist score into release when a critical exception or evidence gap remains.

fields.label: Qualified Quality, Food-Safety, Pharmacy, Or Product-Integrity Reviewer review

sections.title: Cold Chain inspection checklist closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This cold chain inspection checklist is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, contract terms, safety or product requirements, or professional judgment. Stop the affected movement, transfer, release, posting, or disposition when identity, evidence, authorization, or control is uncertain. A qualified qualified quality, food-safety, pharmacy, or product-integrity reviewer must review the exception and document the controlling decision.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted

fields.label: Reviewed by qualified quality, food-safety, pharmacy, or product-integrity reviewer

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated decision; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
